c.h: The purpose of this component is unclear.

是.o: Origin unclear. The bottom component 止 represents the sound.
w: (emphasizes that sth is precisely or exactly as stated)
x: 我是中国人。
Wǒ shì zhōngguórén.
I am Chinese.
就是让她来，也晚了。
Jiùshì ràng tā lái, yě wǎn le.
Even if she comes, it will be too late.
王秀英虽然考了第一，但是她一点也不骄傲。
Wáng Xiùyīng suīrán kǎo le dìyī, dànshì tā yīdiǎn yě bù jiāo'ào.
Although Wang Xiuying scored first in the exam, she was not at all arrogant about it.

㠯.o: Variant form of 以, without the person (人) component. Depicts an object being carried.

c.h: Depicts an axe handle. Original form of 柯.

可.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and the right component, which is a pictograph of an axe handle (now written as 柯), represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "sing", now written as 歌. The current meaning "able to" is a phonetic loan.
w: pitiful; pathetic; to have pity on
x: 他没有家可住。
Tā méiyǒu jiā kě zhù.
He had no place to live.
这里可以拍照吗？
Zhèlǐ kěyǐ pāizhào ma?
May I take pictures here?
他可能被开除了。
Tā kěnéng bèi kāichú le.
He may have been fired.

錯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 金 represents the meaning and 昔 represents the sound. The character is based on the original meaning "grind stone", which later shifted to "mix", "be in disorder", and "wrong".

斯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 斤 represents the meaning and 其 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "cut". Nowadays this character is usually only used for its sound in phonetic loans.
w: this, thus, such; to lop off
x: 法西斯主义是人类的敌人。
Fǎxīsīzhǔyì shì rénlèi de dírén.
Fascism is the enemy of humanity.
他在斯坦福教了十年学。
Tā zài Sītǎnfú jiāo le shínián xué.
He taught at Stanford University for ten years.

嗯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 恩 represents the sound.
x: 嗯，我明白了，那我最好也打扮一下。
Ńg, wǒ míngbái le, nà wǒ zuìhǎo yě dǎbàn yī xià.
Oh, I see. I'd better dress up then.

路.o: Phonosemantic compound. 足 represents the meaning and 各 represents the sound.
w: on the road; on a journey; road surface
the whole journey; all the way
x: 还有一公里的路要走。
Háiyǒu yī gōnglǐ de lù yào zǒu.
There's one more kilometer ahead (of the path)
我现在去你那里的路上了。
Wǒ xiànzài qù nǐ nàlǐ de lùshàng le.
I'm on my way to your place right now.
注意分离式道路。
Zhùyì fēnlíshì dàolù.
Split road ahead.

c.h: Modern form looks like unrelated 止.

肯.o: Depicts meat (⺼) attached to a bone (冎). Based on the original meaning "meat attached to bone". The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
w: to be certain; to be positive; assuredly
to give a nod of approval
would rather...; it would be better...
x: 一路走来肯定不容易。
Yīlù zǒu lái kěndìng bùróngyì.
The journey must have been difficult.
我们肯定是没有钱做什么广告了。
Wǒmen kěndìng shì méiyǒu qián zuò shénme guǎnggào le.
We definitely wouldn't have money for advertising.

c.h: The traditional component 行 was removed for simplification.

术.o: Simplified form of 術. Phonosemantic compound. 行 represents the meaning and 朮 represents the sound. The traditional component 行 was removed for simplification. Based on the original meaning "city road". The meaning later shifted to "way", "method", "technique", and "skill".
w: art, skill, special feat; method, technique
x: 这个技术能让我们的生活更方便。
Zhè ge jìshù néng ràng wǒmen de shēnghuó gèng fāngbiàn.
This technology can make our lives more convenient.
医生说手术会有风险。
Yīshēng shuō shǒushù huì yǒu fēngxiǎn.
The doctor said the operation carries risks.
在现代社会中，艺术起到了怎样的作用？
Zài xiàndài shèhuì zhōng, yìshù qǐ dào le zěnyàng de zuòyòng?
What role does art play in modern societies?

c.h: Alludes to earrings connected to the ear.

c.g: to run threads through a web in weaving

聯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 耳 represents the meaning and 𢇇 represents the sound.

c.h: 自 was the original form of 鼻 (bí; nose).
Originally lines depicting breath. Later reanalyzed as 心 (heart).

息.o: Depicts a breath of air going into the nose (自). The lines representing breath were later reanalyzed as 心 (heart).
w: informatization (the Information Age analog of industrialization)
to choke; to stifle; to suffocate
to rest; to go to sleep; to rest in peace
x: 等你好消息。
Děng nǐ hǎo xiāoxi.
Look forward to hearing the good news.
我们承诺保证您的信息绝对保密。
Wǒmen chéngnuò bǎozhèng nín de xìnxī juéduì bǎomì.
We promise to keep your information absolutely confidential.
他休息了一会儿。
Tā xiūxi le yīhuìr.
He rested for a while.

檯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 臺 represents the sound.

c.h: 犭 is a component form of 犬.

犯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 犭 represents the meaning and 𢎘 represents the sound.
w: to commit a crime; crime; offense
to infringe on; to encroach on; to violate
to break the rules; an illegality; a foul
x: 我不是故意冒犯你。
Wǒ bùshì gùyì màofàn nǐ.
I didn't mean to offend you.
他招认全部犯罪行为。
Tā zhāorèn quánbù fànzuì xíngwèi.
He confessed all his crimes.

c.h: 艹 is a component form of 艸.
Pictograph of a fully bloomed flower.

華.o: Phonosemantic compound. 艹 represents the meaning and 𠌶 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "flower", now written as 花. The meaning later shifted to "blossoming", "flourishing" and "magnificent".

支.o: Pictograph of a hand (又) lifting a piece of bamboo (个).
w: to be in favor of; to support; to back
to prop up; to support; strut
to provide assistance; to support; to back
to spend; to pay out; expense
x: 我问他，他回答支支吾吾。
Wǒ wèn tā, tā huídá zhī zhī wú wú.
I asked him, but he hummed and hawed before answering.
我的态度是同意和支持。
Wǒ de tàidù shì tóngyì hé zhīchí.
I am in agreement and will lend support.
爸爸失去了工作，一家人的生活全靠妈妈支撑。
Bàba shīqù le gōngzuò, yījiārén de shēnghuó quán kào māma zhīchēng.
Dad lost his job, so the whole family had to be supported by mum.

疯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 疒 represents the meaning and 风 represents the sound. Simplified form of 瘋.
w: to go mad; to go crazy; to lose one's mind
to play the fool (idiom); to feign madness
x: 人是不能跟疯子讲道理的。
Rén shì bùnéng gēn fēngzi jiǎngdàolǐ de.
You can't talk reason with crazy people.
他准是开玩笑，要不就是疯了。
Tā zhǔn shì kāi wánxiào, yàobù jiù shì fēng le.
He must be joking or else he's mad.

c.h: Depicts a person whose head is emphasized.

顯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 㬎 represents the sound and 頁 represents the meaning.

c.h: 艹 is a component form of 艸.

药.o: Phonosemantic compound. 艹 represents the meaning and 约 represents the sound. Simplified form of 藥.
w: leaf of Dahurian angelica plant; medicine
x: 同样的药为什么价格相差很多？
Tóngyàng de yào wèishénme jiàgé xiāngchà hěn duō?
Why do prices for the same medicine differ so much?
你对哪种药物过敏吗？
Nǐ duì nǎ zhǒng yàowù guòmǐn ma?
Are you allergic to any medications?

杯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 不 represents the sound.
w: to drink a toast; Cheers! (proposing a toast)
to toast sb (with wine etc); to drink a toast
x: 还想喝一杯吗？
Hái xiǎng hē yī bēi ma?
Would you like another drink?
杯子里没有水。
Bēizǐ lǐ méiyǒu shuǐ.
There isn't any water in the glass.

c.h: 飠 is a component form of 食.

飯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 飠 represents the meaning and 反 represents the sound.

唯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 隹 represents the sound.
w: materialism, philosophical doctrine that physical matter is the…
philosophy of idealism, the doctrine that external reality is a…
the philosophy of materialism, doctrine that physical matter is…
only; just (i.e. it is only that...)
philosophy of idealism, the doctrine that external reality is a…
x: 世界上唯一不变的就是变化。
Shìjiè shàng wéiyī bùbiàn de jiùshì biànhuà.
The only constant in the world is change.
我现在的住所唯有高山，不见大海。
Wǒ xiànzài de zhùsuǒ wéiyǒu gāoshān, bù jiàn dàhǎi.
Where I live now there is no sea, but only high mountains.
我现在唯一挂心的，就是你们的将来。
Wǒ xiànzài wéiyī guàxīn de, jiùshì nǐmen de jiānglái.
The only thing I'm worried about right now is your future.

c.h: Shorthand for the 睘 component in the traditional character 環.

环.o: Simplified form of 環. Phonosemantic compound. 玉 represents the meaning and 睘 represents the sound.
w: (zoology) segment (of the body of a worm, centipede etc)
x: 这款产品很环保。
Zhè kuǎn chǎnpǐn hěn huánbǎo.
This product is very environmentally friendly.
现在越来越多的人认识到环境保护的重要性。
Xiànzài yuèláiyuè duō de rén rènshi dào huánjìngbǎohù de zhòngyàoxìng.
Now more and more people are aware of the importance of environmental protection.

积.o: Phonosemantic compound. 禾 represents the meaning and 只 represents the sound. Simplified form of 積.
w: area (of a floor, piece of land etc)
to save; to put aside; savings
x: 学生们积极性都很高。
Xuéshēng men jījíxìng dōu hěn gāo.
The students are all very enthusiastic.

c.h: 刂 is a component form of 刀.

副.o: Phonosemantic compound. 刂 represents the meaning and 畐 represents the sound.
x: 这种药没有什么副作用。
Zhè zhǒng yào méiyǒu shénme fùzuòyòng.
This medicine has hardly any side effects.
他是我们学校的副校长。
Tā shì wǒmen xuéxiào de fùxiàozhǎng.
He is the vice-principal of our school.

凯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 岂 represents the meaning and 几 represents the sound. Simplified form of 凱.
w: to return in triumph; to return victorious
x: 大家在机场迎接球队凯旋。
Dàjiā zài jīchǎng yíngjiē qiúduì kǎixuán.
Everyone welcomed the team's triumphant return at the airport.

景.o: Phonosemantic compound. 日 represents the meaning and 京 represents the sound.
x: 这个国家有很多美丽的风景。
Zhège guójiā yǒu hěnduō měilì de fēngjǐng.
This country has a lot of beautiful landscapes.
我被这情景吓到了。
Wǒ bèi zhè qíngjǐng xià dào le.
I was frightened by the sight.

c.h: 讠 is a component form of 言.

误.o: Simplified form of 誤. Phonosemantic compound. 言 represents the meaning and 吴 represents the sound.
w: lapse; mistake; to make a mistake
to delay; to hold up; to waste time
x: 很多人误以为竹子是一种树。
Hěnduō rén wù yǐwéi zhúzi shì yī zhǒng shù.
Many people mistakenly believe that bamboo is a tree.
网络错误，请稍后重试。
Wǎngluò cuòwù, qǐng shāohòu chóngshì.
Network error. Please try again later.
请别误解我。
Qǐng bié wùjiě wǒ.
Please don't get me wrong.

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

伯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 白 represents the sound.
w: uncle (polite form of address for older male)
wife of father's elder brother; aunt
x: 我只是随口一问，这回可好，伯伯的话匣子可止不住了。
Wǒ zhǐ shì suíkǒu yī wèn, zhèi huí kě hǎo, bāibai de huàxiázi kě zhǐ bùzhù le.
I was merely asking, but Uncle just wouldn't let his words stop.

良.o: Pictograph of a hallway, now written as 廊. The character is based on the original meaning "hallway". The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
x: 为人师表要有良好的私德。
Wéirénshībiǎo yào yǒu liánghǎo de sīdé.
Good personal morality is required to set an example for others to learn.
这个肿瘤是良性的还是恶性的？
Zhè ge zhǒngliú shì liángxìng de háishì èxìng de?
Is this tumor benign or malignant?
双方合作互动，效果良好。
Shuāngfāng hézuò hùdòng, xiàoguǒ liánghǎo.
The two parties worked well together.

魯.o: Depicts a fish (魚) inside the mouth (甘). Based on the original meaning "tasty". The current meaning is a phonetic loan.

端.o: Phonosemantic compound. 立 represents the meaning and 耑 represents the sound.
w: sharp pointed end; the tip; the cusp
x: 警方端掉贩毒窝点。
Jǐngfāng duān diào fàndú wōdiǎn.
The police destroyed the lair of drug lords.
他们都觉得这个观点太极端，不可取。
Tāmen dōu juéde zhè ge guāndiǎn tài jíduān, bù kěqǔ.
They all think this point of view is too extreme and should not be adopted.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

港.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 巷 represents the sound.
w: natural harbor; bay serving as harbor
x: 香港的夜景真美啊！
Xiānggǎng de yèjǐng zhēn měi a!
Hong Kong's nightscape is so beautiful!
一百元人民币能换多少港币？
Yībǎi yuán rénmínbì néng huàn duōshào gǎngbì?
How many Hong Kong dollars can one hundred renminbi be exchanged for?

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

湯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 昜 represents the sound.

c.h: 欠 is shorthand for the phonetic 耎 component in the variant character 輭.

软.o: Phonosemantic compound. 车 represents the meaning and 耎 represents the sound. Simplified form of 軟.
w: soft candy (gummi candy, gumdrop, jellybean etc)
to be softhearted; to be tenderhearted
x: 他的态度软了下来。
Tā de tàidù ruǎn le xiàlái.
His attitude has softened.
他的声音很软。
Tā de shēngyīn hěn ruǎn.
His voice is very gentle.

灯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 火 represents the meaning and 丁 represents the sound. Simplified form of 燈.
x: 灯光闪耀。
Dēngguāng shǎnyào.
The light shines.
禁止使用闪光灯。
Jìnzhǐ shǐyòng shǎnguāngdēng.
No flash.
你怎么在这儿看书啊，灯光这么暗的，对眼睛多不好啊。
Nǐ zěnme zài zhèr kànshū a, dēngguāng zhème àn de, duì yǎnjing duō bùhǎo a.
Why are you reading here? The light is so dim — it's not good for your eyes.

c.h: 纟 is a component form of 糸.

纯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 纟 represents the meaning and 屯 represents the sound. Simplified form of 純.
w: pure; clean and honest; to purify
to be purely; pure and simple; sheer
x: 这辆车一无是处，纯粹是废品。
Zhè liàng chē yīwúshìchù, chúncuì shì fèipǐn.
This car is a no-good piece of junk, pure waste.
她一直向往着纯洁的爱情。
Tā yīzhí xiàngwǎng zhe chúnjié de àiqíng.
She has always yearned for pure love.
如有雷同，纯属巧合。
Rú yǒu léitóng, chúnshǔ qiǎohé.
Any resemblance to actual individuals or events is purely coincidental.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

振.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 辰 represents the sound.
w: to bestir oneself; to pull oneself together
to stir oneself up; to raise one's spirits
to revive; to revitalize; to invigorate
one stumble, unable to rise (idiom); a setback leading to total…
x: 别难过了，快振作起来。
Bié nánguò le, kuài zhènzuò qǐlái.
Don't be sad; pull yourself together.
手机在桌子上振动了一下。
Shǒujī zài zhuōzi shàng zhèndòng le yīxià.
The phone vibrated once on the table.

匯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 匚 represents the meaning and 淮 represents the sound.

譯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 言 represents the meaning and 睪 represents the sound.

c.h: 忄 is a component form of 心.

惯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 忄 represents the meaning and 贯 represents the sound. Simplified form of 慣.
w: cannot bear to see; to hate; to dislike
x: 我能习惯这样的生活。
Wǒ néng xíguàn zhèyàng de shēnghuó.
I could get used to this kind of life.
我没有睡懒觉的习惯。
Wǒ méiyǒu shuì lǎnjiào de xíguàn.
I'm not used to sleeping in.

c.h: Shorthand for the phonetic component 畾.

累.o: Simplified form of 纍. 田 is shorthand for the phonetic component 畾. 糸 represents the meaning "wind around, bind". The meaning later expanded to "tired".
w: to encumber; to be a burden on; to implicate
x: 我今天累了一整天。
Wǒ jīntiān lèi le yī zhěng tiān.
I've been working hard all day today.
他会累得精疲力竭的。
Tā huì lèi dé jīngpílìjié de.
He'll wear himself out.

c.h: 讠 is a component form of 言. Originally 口 (mouth). Later reanalyzed as 讠 (speech).
Depicts a captive prisoner with their hands tied behind their back.

讯.o: Simplified form of 訊. Depicts a mouth (口) interrogating a captured prisoner of war (卂). 卂 also represents the sound. The 口 (mouth) component was later reanalyzed as 讠 (speech).
x: 现在的通讯技术很发达。
Xiànzài de tōngxùn jìshù hěn fādá.
Communications technology is very advanced nowadays.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

扯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 止 represents the sound. Simplified form of 撦.
w: rip up, tear down; raise; haul
to involve; to implicate; to be interrelated
to talk irresponsibly; to talk nonsense
x: 今天看病要等六个小时，太扯了！
Jīntiān kànbìng yào děng liù ge xiǎoshí, tài chě le!
Today, people had to wait for six hours to see the doctor. It's absolutely ridiculous!
别跟他扯上关系。
Bié gēn tā chě shàng guānxì.
Don't get involved with him.

c.h: 辡 also serves as a meaning component.

辯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 言 represents the meaning and 辡 represents the sound.

启.o: Simplified form of 啟. Depicts a hand (又) opening a door (户) of an opening (口). The 又 (hand) component was later removed for simplification.
w: to start (a machine); to set in motion
to open; to start; (computing) to enable
to enlighten; to explain (a text etc)
to set out on a journey
x: 我看过你的文章，我很受启发。
Wǒ kàn guò nǐ de wénzhāng, wǒ hěn shòu qǐfā.
I have read your article and was very inspired by it.

盯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 目 represents the meaning and 丁 represents the sound.
w: rivet gaze upon, keep eyes on
to watch sb closely; to mark (sports)
to follow sb; to tail; to shadow
to stare fixedly; to look concentratedly
x: 盯著别人看很不礼貌。
Dīng zhe biérén kàn hěn bù lǐmào.
It's not polite to stare.
盯着别人看很不礼貌。
Dīng zhe biérén kàn hěn bù lǐmào.
It's not polite to stare.

梯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 弟 represents the sound.
w: flight of steps; a means of advancement
x: 遇有火灾请勿使用电梯。
Yù yǒu huǒzāi qǐng wù shǐyòng diàntī.
Do not use elevator in case of fire.
书籍是人类进步的阶梯。
Shūjí shì rénlèi jìnbù de jiētī.
The book is the ladder of human progress.

拯.o: To give 丞 a hand 扌; 丞 also provides the pronunciation
x: 医生拯救了他的生命。
Yīshēng zhěngjiù le tā de shēngmìng.
The doctor saved his life.
这部电影讲的是拯救地球的故事。
Zhè bù diànyǐng jiǎng de shì zhěngjiù dìqiú de gùshi.
This film tells a story about saving the Earth.

壯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 士 represents the meaning and 爿 represents the sound.

c.h: Depicts a string through a shell (貝).

贯.o: Simplified form of 貫. Depicts a string of shells (貝), which were used as currency in ancient China.
w: to implement; to put into practice
consistent; constant; from start to finish
a string of 1000 coins; to go through
to win every trick in a card game; grand slam
to link up; to thread together
x: 他做事一贯很认真。
Tā zuòshì yīguàn hěn rènzhēn.
He has always been very conscientious in his work.
学生们全神贯注地听老师讲课。
Xuéshengmen quánshénguànzhù de tīng lǎoshī jiǎngkè.
The students listened to the teacher's lesson with full attention.

闯.o: A horse 马 charging through a gate 门
w: rush in, burst in, charge in
to intrude; to charge in; to gate-crash
to leave home to make one's way in the world
to cause an accident; to make trouble
x: 恭喜，闯关成功！
Gōngxǐ, chuǎngguān chénggōng!
Congratulations, you won!

柯.o: Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 可 represents the sound.
x: 柯老师是我们的班主任。
Kē lǎoshī shì wǒmen de bānzhǔrèn.
